title: SkillFeedback Contract
description: S1 of MAWS-SII-TARGET-SPEC-001 (PROPOSED): structured, versioned feedback record for the Skill Intelligence improvement lifecycle (spec sections 8.2, 8.3, 9 Stage 1). Feedback is analysis input, never authority: a valid record grants no permission, promotes no skill, and changes no qualification state. Model self-report is deterministically excluded as a source category (spec 8.2: model self-report is not independent execution evidence) and may only appear inside observed_problem prose, never as source.category — and never as evidence, enforced structurally by the closed evidence_refs scheme set. positive_reference_example captures carry UNKNOWN_ROOT_CAUSE (no defect attributed) and are therefore forced through the owner-review rule like every other unattributed record. Records with error_class UNKNOWN_ROOT_CAUSE or proposed_disposition CREATE_SKILL always require owner review, and records with error_class TOOL_CONTRACT_ERROR can never carry a skill-changing proposed_disposition (spec: the skill is not the improvement area when the demonstrated cause is exclusively in the tool contract), all enforced by if/then below.

category.description: Allowed feedback input categories per spec 8.2. model_self_report is deliberately absent: it is not independent execution evidence.

subject.description: Run-, skill- and executor-side bindings (spec S1 checklist). Only task_ref is mandatory; the other bindings are declared and filled when the feedback concerns them.

error_class.description: Primary error class per spec 8.3; it determines the responsible improvement area.

evidence_refs.description: At least one evidence anchor per ref, each carrying a closed source-kind scheme (artifact:, edge:, eval:, file:, graph:, operator:, path:, review:, run:, sandbox:, session:, ticket:, url:). The scheme set is closed so model self-report cannot appear as evidence: there is no self-report scheme, and unmarked prose refs are rejected.

proposed_disposition.description: Stage-3 disposition candidate per spec 9; optional at capture time.

source_revision.description: Repository revision the feedback was captured against.
